qualities.guide: Fastest pass. Optimize for immediate iteration and clear core idea. Use simple structure, limited detail, and the smallest practical render. Skip artifact re-check when the generator succeeds. Accept a valid, readable, usable result that communicates the request; do not spend time polishing.

Fast demonstration pass. Make the main idea and interaction visibly convincing with modest detail. Use short, practical generation and one quick sanity check of file validity and obvious composition errors. Accept a coherent result suitable for showing direction, not final delivery.

Balanced production pass. Preserve the user's intent, make all requested parts complete and readable, and use sensible composition, pacing, typography, color, and audio levels. Generate efficiently, inspect the artifact once with the appropriate tool or multimodal view, and repair clear defects. Accept only a complete, technically valid, consistent result.

Expressive production pass. Treat composition, visual language, rhythm, color, typography, texture, and intentional stylization as first-class requirements while preserving the user's intent. Generate, inspect the artifact carefully with multimodal capability when applicable, and self-correct conspicuous technical or artistic defects. Accept a deliberate, cohesive result whose style choices look intentional.

Highest-fidelity pass and slowest mode. Develop specific detail, believable materials and texture, background depth, lighting, shadows, color relationships, motion continuity, and appropriate sound quality. Use multimodal capability to inspect the rendered artifact in detail, compare it against every user requirement, then iterate and self-correct until defects are resolved. Verify technical validity plus semantic completeness, legibility, continuity, and polish. Accept only a convincing, delivery-ready result; report an honest error if a requirement cannot be met.
